channel.title: OpenAI News — Translation & Localization
channel.description: OpenAI news posts filtered for translation, linguistics, and localization topics

item.title: Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API
item.description: Explore new realtime voice models in the OpenAI API that can reason, translate, and transcribe speech, enabling more natural and intelligent voice experiences.

item.title: How We Used Codex to Ship Sora for Android in 28 Days
item.description: OpenAI shipped Sora for Android in 28 days using Codex. AI-assisted planning, translation, and parallel coding workflows helped a nimble team deliver rapid, reliable development.

item.title: Advancing science and math with GPT-5.2
item.description: GPT-5.2 is OpenAI’s strongest model yet for math and science, setting new state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like GPQA Diamond and FrontierMath. This post shows how those gains translate into real research progress, including solving an open theoretical problem and generating reliable mathematical proofs.

item.title: Scam operations: Online fraud networks
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts tied to online fraud networks using AI to support scam scripts, impersonation, translation, and victim engagement.

item.title: Vixen and Keyhole Panda: China-linked cyber operations
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts associated with threat actors publicly attributed to the PRC, using AI to support vulnerability research, scripting, translation, and operational troubleshooting.

item.title: Task scam: AI-assisted fake review jobs
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate messages for fake-review job scams that asked victims to pay fees.

item.title: Romance-baiting scam: AI-assisted pig butchering workflows
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts that appeared to originate in Cambodia and used AI to translate and generate romance, investment scam conversations.

item.title: STORM-0817: Iran-linked malware and scraping activity
item.description: OpenAI banned Iran-linked STORM-0817 accounts using AI to debug Android malware, scrape social platforms, and translate tooling.

item.title: Minnesota’s Enterprise Translation Office uses ChatGPT to bridge language gaps
item.description: Minnesota’s Enterprise Translation Office uses ChatGPT to bridge language gaps

item.title: Operation "Doppelganger": Russian influence activity targeting Ukraine
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Russia-origin operation "Doppelganger", using AI to generate anti-Ukraine social media comments, translations, and website copy across several languages.

item.title: IUVM: Iran-linked influence content network
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts associated with the Iran-origin operation "IUVM", using AI to generate and translate pro-Iran, anti-Israel and anti-US website content.

item.title: OpenAI Codex
item.description: We’ve created an improved version of OpenAI Codex, our AI system that translates natural language to code, and we are releasing it through our API in private beta starting today.

item.title: Better language models and their implications
item.description: We’ve trained a large-scale unsupervised language model which generates coherent paragraphs of text, achieves state-of-the-art performance on many language modeling benchmarks, and performs rudimentary reading comprehension, machine translation, question answering, and summarization—all without task-specific training.
